nodes.label: Rule 1: No fake data — seed = data migrations
nodes.rationale: Business lookup rows (SystemRole.ADMIN, DealStage.RFQ_OPEN, ...) are created via migrations.RunPython with get_or_create; after migrate on a fresh DB every code referenced by services/FSM/permissions must exist. loaddata fixtures and management commands are dev/demo-only; get_or_create in hot paths is a violation.

nodes.label: Rule 8: Business logic lives in services only
nodes.rationale: admin.py actions and DRF ViewSets are thin wrappers (authorize → validate → call ONE service function); never duplicate logic between an admin action and an endpoint — both call the same service (ADR-0001).

nodes.label: PRODUCT RULES (benchmark-first, eyes-on DoD)
nodes.rationale: Owner 2026-07-21: point fixes produced 'visual garbage and dead ends'. Benchmark-first against Odoo/Salesforce CPQ/Bitrix24/PandaDoc; no new gates/SLA without explicit request; owner observations are symptoms not backlog; Definition of Done = scenario walked through with eyes (screenshot/GIF), not green tests.

nodes.label: ARCH-01: AI layer — no LLM call in request path
nodes.rationale: 8 interactive AI endpoints validate synchronously then enqueue sourcing.run_ai_job on dedicated Celery queue 'ai' and answer 202 {task_id}; SPA polls ai-status (IDOR-guarded via AIJob ownership). run_ai_job is single-attempt (max_retries=0) because handlers are paid-per-call and draft_quote writes + consumes a credit — a documented deviation from the Celery retry convention.

nodes.label: Entitlement layer (FeatureKey, ADR-0006 Move 4)
nodes.rationale: SUBSCRIPTION_BASELINE_FEATURES granted by operational SupplierSubscription; explicit CompanyEntitlement rows OVERRIDE — promo grant or DEMO downgrade → watermarked PDF.

nodes.label: KYC floor (ADR-0006 Phase E)
nodes.rationale: Below L2: register + browse + DRAFT заявка only; seller send/export requires KYC L2+ and SELLER_KYC_REQUIRED is checked BEFORE SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED. Verified codes = {L2_VERIFIED, L3_CONTRACTED} — L3_VERIFIED is a phantom code.

nodes.label: Deal FSM (DRAFT → ... → CLOSED_WON/LOST)
nodes.rationale: ALLOWED_STAGE_TRANSITIONS in crm/services/deals.py; Move 0 auto-transitions: send КП → QUOTE_SENT, client approves → CONTRACT_SIGNED (+Contract materialized), dual sign → CLOSED_WON (dispatches auto_invoice_on_closed_won, which creates only a draft invoice + fulfillment — never the act).

nodes.label: Unified capability-driven navigation (ADR-0005)
nodes.rationale: Single buildNavigation(capabilities); /me returns a capabilities object; tiers T0/T1/T2; items are HIDDEN, not disabled.

nodes.label: api-contract gate convention (regenerate on model changes)
nodes.rationale: Any model label/verbose_name change flows into the OpenAPI schema — regenerate spectacular schema + gen:api-types in the same PR or the CI gate fails; because CI regenerates and diffs, the committed schema.json/schema.d.ts can be trusted.

nodes.label: INF-05: generated hashed pip-compile locks
nodes.rationale: requirements.txt/-dev.txt are generated locks — never hand-edit; change floors/caps in requirements.{in,dev.in} and recompile with pip-tools 7.5.3 in a linux py3.12 env with gcc+libpq-dev; psycopg2 built from source (INF-09).

nodes.label: CI coverage threshold 70% (local 30% is a lie-trap)
nodes.rationale: --cov-fail-under=70 in ci.yml gates the merge; fail_under=30 in root pyproject.toml is only the LOCAL report default — the divergence misled until 2026-08-08.

nodes.label: Caddy edge config: repo is source of truth, apply-caddy.yml applies
nodes.rationale: Applied only manually (workflow_dispatch confirmed with the word APPLY) because reload restarts an edge SHARED with a neighboring site; deploy-b2b.yml only checks drift and fails if the live file diverged. Pitfall #554: a matcherless header block CLOBBERS more specific overrides — the admin CSP never worked.
